title: Trainforge Synthesis Summary
description: Per-run sidecar emitted by `Trainforge/synthesis/synthesize_training.py::run_synthesis` next to `dataset_config.json` (default `<course>/training_specs/synthesis_summary.json`). Records canonical source coverage and per-surface pair counts so the promotion-chain aggregator can attribute dropped pairs. The artifact is optional for older builds. The same numbers are mirrored into `dataset_config.json::statistics.promotion_ladder`; this sidecar is the canonical aggregation surface.

schema_version.description: Schema-contract version. Bumped only when the emit shape changes.

course_code.description: Canonical course code passed into run_synthesis.

provider.description: Synthesis provider used for the run (mock | anthropic | claude_session | together | local).

reject_mining.description: OPTIONAL reject-mined-DPO-negative funnel, emitted only when TRAINFORGE_DPO_MINE_REJECTS is `shadow` or `on` (absent entirely when the flag is off, so a legacy sidecar is byte-identical). Counters are the capture-pool tallies plus the selection funnel (candidates_seen -> ... -> emitted); `mode_shadow` is 1 when the pass ran in shadow (selected but emitted nothing). This block is the ONLY durable surface for a shadow run: an operator reads `emitted` here to decide whether the corpus would clear the trainer's `min_dpo_pairs: 50` floor before flipping the flag to `on`. Not schema-versioned separately and NOT a `schema_version` bump: an absent-or-present optional key cannot break a reader.

reject_mining_skipped.description: Present only when the pass mined nothing for a structural reason rather than a count (currently `incomplete_pass` — the generation pass stopped early or exhausted its dispatch budget, so the reject pool is partial and a partial pool is a biased pool).

source_coverage.description: Canonical W3.H source_coverage block. Drop reason codes for the H5 synthesis arrow: the W2.E TrainingPairPromotionValidator rejection codes (placeholder_residue, unsupported_answer, weak_distractor, unanswerable_stem, source_free_generation, low_bloom_alignment, generic_rationale) plus any legacy per-pair rejection codes from SynthesisStats.rejected_reasons. The `internal_drop_reason_missing` bucket fires when the silent-gaming check trips.
